messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — our LAX cluster is dipping below soft-cap for GPU pool B. SLOs in non-critical queues are seeing latency spikes. We need ETA on the backfill and options for temporary loaner units. Can you ping the vendor and see if we can split the shipment or expedite a partial release?

jake_sourcing: On it. Vendor says full batch delayed 6–8 business days due to carrier congestion. They can do a partial release of 8 units next-week if we cover expedited freight and a small premium. Do we want to accept partial + loaners? @lena_logistics any customs/forwarder constraints for an expedited air split? :thinking_face: 

lena_logistics: Expedited air is fine for LAX but customs team flagged new paperwork requirements for high-value electronics — might add 1 business day if we don't pre-clear. Forwarder quotes: standard -> 48h door, expedited -> 24h door but +$1,200 per AWB. If we accept partial, recommend we pre-initiate commercial invoice + HS code 847330 to avoid hold.
jake_sourcing: Noted. Vendor proposed premium is +6% per unit for expedited split. That plus forwarder means ~+8–9% cost. We can eat part via Ops contingency; need sign-off from finance.
maria_ops: Finance already said up to +5% without review. If total ~9% we need an approval. But cluster impact is now — can we get loaners to bridge until the split arrives? 
vendor_tech: We have two options from vendor: (A) ship 8 brand-new units now (partial release) and reserve the rest, or (B) dispatch 12 certified-refurb loaners from their depots (lower cost, 90-day loan, refurb grade A) while full batch ships. Loaners require a signed short-term LOA and an RMA holdback for serials. They can change forwarder on the loaner leg to keep cost down.
lena_logistics: Loaners -> simpler customs (they mark as temporary export), but you must provide temporary import bond info. If we accept loaners + partial new units, we'll have 2 inbound shipments with separate AWBs and different insurance. Ops will need to track twin manifests in our inventory system.
jake_sourcing: Vendor attached preliminary manifest and serials for loaners and new units. Sample: ```
NEW: AWB 123-45678901
Serials: RX-9001, RX-9002, RX-9003, RX-9004, RX-9005, RX-9006, RX-9007, RX-9008
LOANER: AWB 234-56789012
Serials: LN-4001..LN-4012
```
maria_ops: Can vendor commit to same-day RMA acceptance if any DOA on the partial release? Last time we had a 3-day acceptance window and that broke our ops SLOs.
vendor_tech: We can request same-day RMA triage at vendor depot for the partial release — vendor says they will commit SLAs: 24h triage and either swap or issue loaner within 48h of DOA confirmation. Need to bake that into the PO addendum.
ops_bot: ops_bot created RMA ticket RMA-2026 linked to this thread. (automated)

maria_ops: Ok — proposal: accept option A (ship 8 new units) + request 12 loaners as contingency, pre-clear customs docs, and sign PO addendum with 24h triage & 48h swap SLA. Finance to sign for up to +5% now; remainder we will ask for credit or offset on next invoice. @jake_sourcing escalate to procurement for quick approval.
jake_sourcing: Escalating to procurement/finance. Also asking vendor to provide test logs and thermal sensor logs for the 8 units before dispatch — helps avoid returns. Vendor asked for our pre-signed temporary import bond form for loaners.
lena_logistics: I can pre-fill the CI and HS entries and send to customs for pre-clear. Share the AWB ASAP.
vendor_tech: Can provide thermal logs. Also request our depot address and contact for direct handoff. One caveat: the vendor flagged that if we request alternate forwarder after manifest finalization there is a $400 re-route fee per AWB.
maria_ops: Noted — we'll avoid changes post-manifest. 

jake_sourcing: Quick check — does accepting loaners change the warranty terms for the new units? We need to ensure loaners don't void vendor warranty on new units.
vendor_tech: Loaners are under separate LOA and do not affect warranty on new units. Will include explicit clause in addendum.
maria_ops: Great. If procurement signs, schedule inbound receiving window for May 10–12 (provisional). @lena_logistics please reserve dock slot and customs clearance agent.
lena_logistics: Reserved provisional dock slot May 11. I'll update once AWB confirmed.

ops_bot: ops_bot updated inventory plan: create placeholder entries for 8 incoming units + 12 loaners. Inventory IDs reserved. (automated)

maria_ops: Thanks team. Final ask: vendor — please confirm pickup ETA and provide final AWBs and expected arrival timestamps (ETD/ETA). We need those to open temporary capacity routes on the cluster.
vendor_tech: Confirmed — pickup scheduled tonight ETD 2026-05-06T22:00Z, ETA LAX 2026-05-10T14:30Z for new partial, loaners ETA 2026-05-09T09:00Z. Final AWBs will be posted in 2–3h.
maria_ops: Perfect. Once AWBs are in, I'll coordinate patching and node tagging for fast commissioning. :thumbsup:
